view.name: Subscriptions feed
view.description: RSS subscription feed with channel avatar strip and a grid of feed item cards showing queue status.

regions.label: 80px icon navigation rail with VidBee bee logo, Home/Subscribe/Tools destinations (Subscribe active with pale amber tile), Preferences and About icons pinned at bottom
Horizontal row of channel avatar buttons (All + 8 subscribed channels) with sync-status dots, acting as single-select filter; dashed-circle 'Add subscription' button at right
Reverse-chronological 4-column grid of video cards from all subscribed channels; each card has channel pill, thumbnail or 'No thumbnail' gradient, timestamp, Queued/Not queued pill and bold title

evidence.note: Persistent left rail with icon+label destinations, settings/info at bottom
'All' pressed; clicking a channel avatar (verified live) instantly narrows grid to that channel's videos
Aggregated stream of videos from followed channels, newest first by publish timestamp

novel.description: Feed laid out as a uniform fixed-height multi-column card grid (4 equal columns, equal row heights), not a single column, side-by-side feeds, or masonry

evidence.note: Thumbnail area (or 'No thumbnail' gradient placeholder) with overlaid channel pill, date and queue status; title below on page background

evidence.quote: 十年老笔记本还能干什么？

evidence.note: Green status pill per video; dark 'Not queued' variant
Status dot on channel avatar: green = up to date, red = fetch error (404)
Hovering a channel avatar shows a hover card below it (verified live): 'Urbanism Now / Status code 404 / Updated: 2026-11-17 22:18'
Hover surface is a multi-line card with title, status and timestamp; coded as popover (hover card) instead
Verified live: opens centered 'Add subscription' dialog over dimmed backdrop with Feed URL field, custom directory + Browse, auto-download toggles, Cancel/Add

structure.layout: app layout: fixed 80px left icon rail; main area with horizontal channel-avatar filter strip on top and a 4-column grid of video cards scrolling in a panel

aesthetics.typography: Open Sans throughout: bold 16px card titles, 12px regular for channel pills, timestamps and status pills, 12-14px nav labels
aesthetics.typeScale: Compressed scale: 16px bold titles vs 12px meta (white on dark gradient overlays); hierarchy carried by weight and contrast more than size; title-art thumbnails carry large ~26px bold text

notes: Cards are 18px-rounded thumbnail tiles; when a video lacks a thumbnail a light gray-to-dark vertical gradient with centered 'No thumbnail' text is shown so overlaid white text (date, channel pill) stays legible. Metadata sits as overlays: dark translucent channel pill with mini avatar top-left, timestamp bottom-left, green 'Queued' / black 'Not queued' pill bottom-right. Channel strip uses colored gradient initial avatars (LC, OM, 陈…) with green/red sync dots; hover shows a status hover card (e.g. 'Status code 404'). Add-subscription is a dashed-circle '+' button. Amber/honey brand (bee logo, pale amber active-nav tile, yellow Add button in dialog). Mixed English/Chinese content. Proposed new feed arrangement value 'uniform-grid'.
